description.value: Vietnam Village is a family-run Vietnamese restaurant that has served Kelowna since 2002 from its location on busy Highway 97. The menu spans Phở, Bánh mì, fresh salad rolls, vermicelli bowls, and chef specials, with a wide range of vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free options. Cyclists passing through on the Okanagan corridor will find a fully licensed sit-down dining room alongside takeout and delivery options.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content was successfully fetched and provides strong evidence for most fields. The homepage confirms dine-in, takeout, full liquor licence, and vegetarian/vegan options; the menu pages confirm gluten-free items; the contact page provides address (1961 Harvey Avenue, Hwy 97), phone (250-862-9080), and email not present in OSM. No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or Wi-Fi anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM record contains no address, phone, or email; all contact details were sourced from the website. The address (1961 Harvey Avenue, Hwy 97) and phone (250-862-9080) should be added to the OSM node.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: An established, family-run restaurant open since 2002 on a key Okanagan cycling corridor (Hwy 97), with dine-in, takeout, and strong vegetarian/vegan/GF options — a clear benefit to touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: Catering services for events (reunions, club outings, weddings) mentioned on the homepage — potentially useful for organised cycling groups.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Homepage states 'many vegetarian and vegan options'; menu labels crispy pork spring rolls and fresh salad rolls as 'gluten-free'; a dedicated Vegetarian Menu section is present; tofu substitutions offered across multiple dishes

wow_evidence: family-run Vietnamese restaurant that has served Kelowna since 2002
